testsuite.name: com.chimali.fido2.data.transport.FidoBleLifecycleTest

testcase.name: disconnect stops advertising, clears active host, and transitions to Idle()
duplicate connect calls are idempotent and do not restart advertiser()
disconnect is idempotent when called repeatedly()
connect starts advertising and transitions connection state to Advertising()
notification completion from previous host does not advance successor queue()
authentication failure stops advertising until explicit retry()
disconnect increments session generation to fence late incoming packets()
late disconnect callback from previous host does not disturb the successor session()
single host exclusivity rejects second peer while first peer is active()
outbound connectDevice fails immediately with UnsupportedOutboundConnectionException()
connect registers FIDO service before advertising and closes server on stop()
unexpected peer disconnect cancels the active CTAP operation and drops its response()
failed BLE link surfaces pairing recovery error after session cleanup()
connect failure transitions to Error state and returns failure()
incomplete request autonomously sends timeout error after three seconds()
